classification.difficultyReason: Use parallel sides to infer the combined unlabelled tip angles, incorporate a reflex notch angle into the polygon sum, then convert the remaining interior angle to the requested reflex angle.

content.prompt: Find the value of the pronumeral in these diagrams.

spec.description: Pentagon with a single equality tick on each side; the bottom side extends through the lower-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Five equal sides are marked. No equal-angle or regularity condition is supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the unknown exterior angle x is visible.

answer.worked:
The pentagon is regular, so its five interior angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(5-2)=540^\circ\\I&=\frac{540^\circ}{5}=108^\circ\\x&=180^\circ-108^\circ\\x&=72^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Pentagon with a vertical left-side extension, exterior 50°, interior f, g, 150°, 95° and a right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: f and 50° are supplementary; the five interior angles total 540°.
spec.answerVisibility: All numerical givens and unknowns are visible; supplied answers are omitted.

spec.description: Hexagon with two extended sloping sides, exterior x°, two exterior 30° angles, interior 100° and 110°, and an interior right angle.
spec.mathematics: The two 30° exterior angles give interior angles of 150°; the interior angle at x is 180°−x.

answer.worked:
Each interior angle adjacent to $30^\circ$ is $150^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(6-2)=720^\circ\\(180-x)+100+110+150+90+150&=720\\780-x&=720\\x&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Pentagon with exterior 70°, an exterior right angle, exterior 40°, interior d adjacent to exterior c, and a bottom-right right angle. All source extensions are retained.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles are 110°, 90°, 140°, d and 90°; c+d=180°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and c, d are visible.

spec.description: Concave pentagon with 16° at the left tip, 40° in the small exterior notch angle, 85° at the bottom, x° at the right and single-arrow parallel marks on the long left and upper-right sides.
spec.mathematics: The notch interior angle is 320°. Parallel sides give a top angle of 40°−16°=24°, hence x=95°.

answer.worked:
The parallel sides give the top angle as $40^\circ-16^\circ=24^\circ$. The reflex interior angle at the notch is $360^\circ-40^\circ=320^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(5-2)=540^\circ\\16+320+24+x+85&=540\\x+445&=540\\x&=95^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Concave hexagon with left notch, interior 50° and 40°, exterior 60°, right-angle square and x°. Matching double arrows identify parallel upper-left and lower-right sides.
spec.mathematics: The top interior angle is 120°; parallel sides give a 90° small notch angle and a 270° reflex interior angle.

answer.worked:
The top interior angle is $180^\circ-60^\circ=120^\circ$. The parallel sides give the small notch angle as $50^\circ+40^\circ=90^\circ$, so its reflex interior angle is $270^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(6-2)=720^\circ\\50+120+90+x+40+270&=720\\x+570&=720\\x&=150^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Concave hexagon with a right-hand notch, 75°, 40°, 100° and x°. A square marks the small exterior notch angle; double arrows mark parallel top and bottom sides.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left interior angle is 105°; the notch interior angle is 270°.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles give the lower-left angle as $180^\circ-75^\circ=105^\circ$. The reflex notch angle is $360^\circ-90^\circ=270^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(6-2)=720^\circ\\75+40+270+100+x+105&=720\\x+590&=720\\x&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Concave hexagon with parallel upper-left and lower-right sides, interior 120° and 150°, a 95° small exterior notch angle and a large reflex exterior x° arc at the upper-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: The two unlabelled tip angles total 95°. The notch interior angle is 265°. The upper-right interior angle is 90°, so the marked reflex exterior angle is 270°.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied 270 is omitted; the reflex sector for x remains visible.

answer.worked:
The parallel sides give a total of $95^\circ$ for the two unlabelled tip angles. The reflex notch angle is $360^\circ-95^\circ=265^\circ$. Let the upper-right interior angle be $a$.
$$\begin{align*}S&=180(6-2)=720^\circ\\95+120+a+150+265&=720\\a+630&=720\\a&=90^\circ\\x&=360^\circ-90^\circ\\x&=270^\circ\end{align*}$$
